verses.original: בַּשָּׁנָה֙ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔ית בָּעֲשִׂרִ֕י בִּשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: baš·šā·nāh hā·‘ă·śî·rîṯ bā·‘ă·śi·rî biš·nêm ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the tenth year on the twelfth . . . day of the tenth month the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: NO décimo ano, no décimo mês, no dia doze do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם שִׂ֣ים פָּנֶ֔יךָ עַל־ פַּרְעֹ֖ה מֶ֣לֶךְ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהִנָּבֵ֣א עָלָ֔יו וְעַל־ מִצְרַ֖יִם כֻּלָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm pā·ne·ḵā ‘al- par·‘ōh me·leḵ miṣ·rā·yim wə·hin·nā·ḇê ‘ā·lāw wə·‘al- miṣ·ra·yim kul·lāh
verses.literal: Son of man set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him and against all Egypt
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, dirige o teu rosto contra Faraó, rei do Egito, e profetiza contra ele e contra todo o Egito.

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֨ר וְאָמַרְתָּ֜ כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֤י עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם הַתַּנִּים֙ הַגָּד֔וֹל הָרֹבֵ֖ץ בְּת֣וֹךְ יְאֹרָ֑יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָמַ֛ר לִ֥י יְאֹרִ֖י וַאֲנִ֥י עֲשִׂיתִֽנִי׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr wə·’ā·mar·tā kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî ‘ā·le·ḵā par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim hat·tan·nîm hag·gā·ḏō·wl hā·rō·ḇêṣ bə·ṯō·wḵ yə·’ō·rāw ’ă·šer ’ā·mar lî yə·’ō·rî wa·’ă·nî ‘ă·śî·ṯi·nî
verses.literal: Speak to him and tell him that this is what the Lord GOD says Behold I am against you O Pharaoh king of Egypt O great monster who lies among his rivers who says The Nile is mine I made it myself
verses.literalPt: Fala, e dize: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis-me contra ti, ó Faraó, rei do Egito, grande dragão, que pousas no meio dos teus rios, e que dizes: O meu rio é meu, e eu o fiz para mim.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י חַחִיִּים בִּלְחָיֶ֔יךָ וְהִדְבַּקְתִּ֥י דְגַת־ יְאֹרֶ֖יךָ בְּקַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶ֑יךָ וְהַעֲלִיתִ֙יךָ֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ יְאֹרֶ֔יךָ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ דְּגַ֣ת יְאֹרֶ֔יךָ בְּקַשְׂקְשֹׂתֶ֖יךָ תִּדְבָּֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḥa·ḥī·yīm bil·ḥā·ye·ḵā wə·hiḏ·baq·tî ḏə·ḡaṯ- yə·’ō·re·ḵā bə·qaś·qə·śō·ṯe·ḵā wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯî·ḵā mit·tō·wḵ yə·’ō·re·ḵā wə·’êṯ kāl- də·ḡaṯ yə·’ō·re·ḵā bə·qaś·qə·śō·ṯe·ḵā tiḏ·bāq
verses.literal: But I will put hooks in your jaws and cause the fish of your streams to cling to your scales I will haul you up out of your rivers and all the fish of your streams will cling to your scales
verses.literalPt: Mas eu porei anzóis em teus queixos, e farei que os peixes dos teus rios se apeguem às tuas escamas; e tirar-te-ei do meio dos teus rios, e todos os peixes dos teus rios se apegarem às tuas escamas.

verses.original: וּנְטַשְׁתִּ֣יךָ הַמִּדְבָּ֗רָה אוֹתְךָ֙ וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ דְּגַ֣ת יְאֹרֶ֔יךָ עַל־ פְּנֵ֤י הַשָּׂדֶה֙ תִּפּ֔וֹל לֹ֥א תֵאָסֵ֖ף וְלֹ֣א תִקָּבֵ֑ץ לְחַיַּ֥ת הָאָ֛רֶץ וּלְע֥וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם נְתַתִּ֥יךָ לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṭaš·tî·ḵā ham·miḏ·bā·rāh ’ō·wṯ·ḵā wə·’êṯ kāl- də·ḡaṯ yə·’ō·re·ḵā ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh tip·pō·wl lō ṯê·’ā·sêp̄ wə·lō ṯiq·qā·ḇêṣ lə·ḥay·yaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ū·lə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim nə·ṯat·tî·ḵā lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: I will leave you in the desert you and all the fish of your streams You will fall on the open field and will not be taken away . . . or gathered for burial I have given you as food to the beasts of the earth and the birds of the air
verses.literalPt: E te deixarei no deserto, a ti e a todo o peixe dos teus rios; sobre a face do campo cairás; não serás recolhido nem ajuntado; aos animais da terra e às aves do céu te dei por mantimento.

verses.original: וְיָֽדְעוּ֙ כָּל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י מִצְרַ֔יִם כִּ֖י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יַ֧עַן הֱיוֹתָ֛ם מִשְׁעֶ֥נֶת קָנֶ֖ה לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kāl- yō·šə·ḇê miṣ·ra·yim kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ya·‘an hĕ·yō·w·ṯām miš·‘e·neṯ qā·neh lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then all the people of Egypt will know that I am the LORD For you were only a staff of reeds to the house of Israel
verses.literalPt: E saberão todos os moradores do Egito que eu sou o SENHOR, porquanto se tornaram um bordão de cana para a casa de Israel.

verses.original: בְּתָפְשָׂ֨ם בְּךָ֤ בַכַּפְךָ תֵּר֔וֹץ וּבָקַעְתָּ֥ לָהֶ֖ם כָּל־ כָּתֵ֑ף וּבְהִֽשָּׁעֲנָ֤ם עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ תִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר וְהַעֲמַדְתָּ֥ לָהֶ֖ם כָּל־ מָתְנָֽיִם׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·ṯā·p̄ə·śām bə·ḵā ḇak·kap̄·ḵå̄ tê·rō·wṣ ū·ḇā·qa‘·tā lā·hem kāl- kā·ṯêp̄ ū·ḇə·hiš·šā·‘ă·nām ‘ā·le·ḵā tiš·šā·ḇêr wə·ha·‘ă·maḏ·tā lā·hem kāl- mā·ṯə·nā·yim
verses.literal: When Israel took hold of you with their hands you splintered tearing all their shoulders when they leaned on you you broke and their backs were wrenched
verses.literalPt: Tomando-te eles pela mão, te quebraste, e lhes rasgaste todo o ombro; e quando se apoiaram em ti, te quebraste, e lhes fazias tremer todos os seus lombos.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֛י מֵבִ֥יא עָלַ֖יִךְ חָ֑רֶב וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֵּ֖ךְ אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî mê·ḇî ‘ā·la·yiḵ ḥā·reḇ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·mêḵ ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD . . . says I will bring a sword against you and cut off from you man and beast
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu trarei sobre ti a espada, e de ti destruirei homem e animal,

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה אֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לִשְׁמָמָ֣ה וְחָרְבָּ֔ה וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה יַ֧עַן אָמַ֛ר יְאֹ֥ר לִ֖י וַאֲנִ֥י עָשִֽׂיתִי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ’e·reṣ- miṣ·ra·yim liš·mā·māh wə·ḥā·rə·bāh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh ya·‘an ’ā·mar yə·’ōr lî wa·’ă·nî ‘ā·śî·ṯî
verses.literal: The land of Egypt will become a desolate wasteland Then they will know that I am the LORD Because you said The Nile is mine I made it
verses.literalPt: E a terra do Egito se tornará em desolação e deserto; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR, porquanto disse: O rio é meu, e eu o fiz.

verses.original: לָכֵ֛ן הִנְנִ֥י אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְאֶל־ יְאֹרֶ֑יךָ וְנָתַתִּ֞י אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם לְחָרְבוֹת֙ חֹ֣רֶב שְׁמָמָ֔ה מִמִּגְדֹּ֥ל סְוֵנֵ֖ה וְעַד־ גְּב֥וּל כּֽוּשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên hin·nî ’ê·le·ḵā wə·’el- yə·’ō·re·ḵā wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim lə·ḥā·rə·ḇō·wṯ ḥō·reḇ šə·mā·māh mim·miḡ·dōl sə·wê·nêh wə·‘aḏ- gə·ḇūl kūš
verses.literal: therefore I am against you and against your rivers I will turn the land of Egypt into a ruin a desolate wasteland from Migdol to Syene and as far as the border of Cush
verses.literalPt: Portanto, eis que eu estou contra ti, e contra os teus rios; e tornarei a terra do Egito deserta, em completa desolação, desde a torre de Syene até aos confins da Etiópia.

verses.original: לֹ֤א תַעֲבָר־ בָּהּ֙ רֶ֣גֶל אָדָ֔ם וְרֶ֥גֶל בְּהֵמָ֖ה לֹ֣א תַעֲבָר־ בָּ֑הּ וְלֹ֥א תֵשֵׁ֖ב אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇār- bāh re·ḡel ’ā·ḏām wə·re·ḡel bə·hê·māh lō ṯa·‘ă·ḇār- bāh wə·lō ṯê·šêḇ ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: No foot of man or beast will pass through - and it will be uninhabited for forty years
verses.literalPt: Não passará por ela pé de homem, nem pé de animal passará por ela, nem será habitada quarenta anos.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אֶת־ אֶרֶץ֩ מִצְרַ֨יִם שְׁמָמָ֜ה בְּת֣וֹךְ׀ אֲרָצ֣וֹת נְשַׁמּ֗וֹת וְעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּת֨וֹךְ עָרִ֤ים מָֽחֳרָבוֹת֙ תִּֽהְיֶ֣יןָ שְׁמָמָ֔ה אַרְבָּעִ֖ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַהֲפִצֹתִ֤י אֶת־ מִצְרַ֙יִם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְֽזֵרִיתִ֖ים בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim šə·mā·māh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ nə·šam·mō·wṯ wə·‘ā·re·hā bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘ā·rîm mā·ḥo·rā·ḇō·wṯ tih·ye·nā šə·mā·māh ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh wa·hă·p̄i·ṣō·ṯî ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim bag·gō·w·yim wə·zê·rî·ṯîm bā·’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will make the land of Egypt a desolation among desolate lands and her cities will lie desolate for forty years among the ruined cities And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations and scatter them throughout the countries
verses.literalPt: Porque tornarei a terra do Egito em desolação no meio das terras desoladas; e as suas cidades entre as cidades desertas se tornarão em desolação por quarenta anos; e espalharei os egípcios entre as nações, e os dispersarei pelas terras.

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה מִקֵּ֞ץ אַרְבָּעִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ אֲקַבֵּ֣ץ אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם מִן־ הָעַמִּ֖ים אֲשֶׁר־ נָפֹ֥צוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: kî kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh miq·qêṣ ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh ’ă·qab·bêṣ ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim min- hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer- nā·p̄ō·ṣū šām·māh
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says At the end of forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations to which they were scattered . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Ao fim de quarenta anos ajuntarei os egípcios dentre os povos entre os quais foram espalhados.

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ שְׁב֣וּת מִצְרַ֔יִם וַהֲשִׁבֹתִ֤י אֹתָם֙ אֶ֣רֶץ פַּתְר֔וֹס עַל־ אֶ֖רֶץ מְכֽוּרָתָ֑ם וְהָ֥יוּ שָׁ֖ם מַמְלָכָ֥ה שְׁפָלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tî ’eṯ- šə·ḇūṯ miṣ·ra·yim wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî ’ō·ṯām ’e·reṣ paṯ·rō·ws ‘al- ’e·reṣ mə·ḵū·rā·ṯām wə·hā·yū šām mam·lā·ḵāh šə·p̄ā·lāh
verses.literal: I will restore Egypt from captivity and bring them back to the land of Pathros the land of their origin There they will be a lowly kingdom
verses.literalPt: E removerei o cativeiro dos egípcios, e os farei voltar à terra de Patros, à terra de sua origem; e serão ali um reino humilde;

verses.original: מִן־ הַמַּמְלָכוֹת֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה שְׁפָלָ֔ה וְלֹֽא־ תִתְנַשֵּׂ֥א ע֖וֹד עַל־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם וְהִ֨מְעַטְתִּ֔ים לְבִלְתִּ֖י רְד֥וֹת בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: min- ham·mam·lā·ḵō·wṯ tih·yeh šə·p̄ā·lāh wə·lō- ṯiṯ·naś·śê ‘ō·wḏ ‘al- hag·gō·w·yim wə·him·‘aṭ·tîm lə·ḇil·tî rə·ḏō·wṯ bag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: Egypt will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations For I will diminish Egypt so that it will never again rule over the nations
verses.literalPt: Mais humilde se fará do que os outros reinos, e nunca mais se exalçará sobre as nações; porque os diminuirei, para que não dominem sobre as nações.

verses.original: וְלֹ֣א יִֽהְיֶה־ עוֹד֩ לְבֵ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְמִבְטָח֙ מַזְכִּ֣יר עָוֺ֔ן בִּפְנוֹתָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְיָ֣דְע֔וּ כִּ֥י אֲנִ֖י אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yih·yeh- ‘ō·wḏ lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl lə·miḇ·ṭāḥ maz·kîr ‘ā·wōn bip̄·nō·w·ṯām ’a·ḥă·rê·hem wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî ’ă·nî ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Egypt will never . . . again be an object of trust for the house of Israel but will remind them of their iniquity in turning to the Egyptians Then they will know that I am the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: E não será mais a confiança da casa de Israel, para lhes trazer à lembrança a sua iniqüidade, quando olharem para trás deles; antes saberão que eu sou o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּעֶשְׂרִ֤ים וָשֶׁ֙בַע֙ שָׁנָ֔ה בָּֽרִאשׁ֖וֹן בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·‘eś·rîm wā·še·ḇa‘ šā·nāh bā·ri·šō·wn bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the twenty-seventh . . . year on the first day of the first month the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, no ano vinte e sete, no primeiro mês, no primeiro dia do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּ֠בֶל הֶעֱבִ֨יד אֶת־ חֵיל֜וֹ עֲבֹדָ֤ה גְדֹלָה֙ אֶל־ צֹ֔ר כָּל־ רֹ֣אשׁ מֻקְרָ֔ח וְכָל־ כָּתֵ֖ף מְרוּטָ֑ה וְ֠שָׂכָר לֹא־ הָ֨יָה ל֤וֹ וּלְחֵילוֹ֙ מִצֹּ֔ר עַל־ הָעֲבֹדָ֖ה אֲשֶׁר־ עָבַ֥ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel he·‘ĕ·ḇîḏ ’eṯ- ḥê·lōw ‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh ḡə·ḏō·lāh ’el- ṣōr kāl- rōš muq·rāḥ wə·ḵāl kā·ṯêp̄ mə·rū·ṭāh wə·śā·ḵār lō- hā·yāh lōw ū·lə·ḥê·lōw miṣ·ṣōr ‘al- hā·‘ă·ḇō·ḏāh ’ă·šer- ‘ā·ḇaḏ ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Son of man Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously . . . against Tyre Every head was made bald and every shoulder made raw But he and his army received no wages from Tyre for the labor they expended on it
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, fez com que o seu exército prestasse um grande serviço contra Tiro; toda a cabeça se tornou calva, e todo o ombro se pelou; e não houve paga de Tiro para ele, nem para o seu exército, pelo serviço que prestou contra ela.

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה הִנְנִ֥י נֹתֵ֛ן לִנְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְנָשָׂ֨א הֲמֹנָ֜הּ וְשָׁלַ֤ל שְׁלָלָהּ֙ וּבָזַ֣ז בִּזָּ֔הּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה שָׂכָ֖ר לְחֵילֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh hin·nî nō·ṯên lin·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·nā·śā hă·mō·nāh wə·šā·lal šə·lā·lāh ū·ḇā·zaz biz·zāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh śā·ḵār lə·ḥê·lōw
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD . . . says I will give the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon who will carry off its wealth seize its spoil and remove its plunder This will be the wages for his army
verses.literalPt: Portanto, assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Eis que eu darei a Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia, a terra do Egito; e levará a sua multidão, e tomará o seu despojo, e roubará a sua presa, e isto será a recompensa para o seu exército.

verses.original: פְּעֻלָּתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁר־ עָ֣בַד בָּ֔הּ נָתַ֥תִּי ל֖וֹ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ עָ֣שׂוּ לִ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: pə·‘ul·lā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- ‘ā·ḇaḏ bāh nā·ṯat·tî lōw ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū lî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: I have given him the land of Egypt as the reward for his labor because it was done for Me declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Como recompensa do seu trabalho, com que serviu contra ela, lhe dei a terra do Egito; porquanto trabalharam por mim, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא אַצְמִ֤יחַ קֶ֙רֶן֙ לְבֵ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּלְךָ֛ אֶתֵּ֥ן פִּתְחֽוֹן־ פֶּ֖ה בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū ’aṣ·mî·aḥ qe·ren lə·ḇêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·lə·ḵā ’et·tên piṯ·ḥō·wn- peh bə·ṯō·w·ḵām wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel and I will open your mouth to speak among them Then they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Naquele dia farei brotar o poder na casa de Israel, e abrirei a tua boca no meio deles; e saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.
